0022600163.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 3-1 at home) host the Chicago Bulls (1-5, 14th in the East, 0-2 at home), who have lost four straight, while Philadelphia is riding a two-game winning streak. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Joel Embiid (foot), and LeBron James (back), all listed as out, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Dailyn Swain (back soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2 and won their most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
